flintclient.ncr.gui.secure_chat: This option cannot work with No Chat Reports, since there are no signatures to verify.
flintclient.ncr.gui.no_reporting: Chat reports are disabled on this server, courtesy of No Chat Reports.
flintclient.ncr.disconnect.client: This server does not have No Chat Reports and you have configured it to require itself on server.
flintclient.ncr.gui.safety_status_button: Left-click to cycle between signing modes.
flintclient.ncr.gui.safety_status.secure: This server has No Chat Reports installed, or prevents your messages from being reportable in some other known way. You can chat safely.
flintclient.ncr.gui.safety_status.single: You can always chat safely in singleplayer and self-hosted LAN worlds.
flintclient.ncr.gui.safety_status.unintr: This server allows you to send unsigned messages which cannot be reported to Mojang. Unless some kind of plugin is installed on the server that prevents chat reports - vanilla clients will still send signed messages, display unsigned messages as "Unverified" and not show them if "Only Show Secure Chat" is enabled in chat options.
flintclient.ncr.gui.safety_status.insecu: This server currently demands all chat messages to be signed. All signed messages are a potentially incriminating evidence that can be used against you in a chat report.
You have enabled chat signing, which makes all your messages a potentially incriminating evidence that can be used against you in a chat report.
flintclient.ncr.gui.safety_status.realms: This is a Realms server. Not only is there no way to prevent chat reports here, but Mojang also employs automated chat monitoring to identify potential "online harms" and escalate them to human review, whether the owner of the Realm likes it or not.
flintclient.ncr.gui.safety_status.unknow: No Chat Reports is not sure about safety of this server yet. Try sending a message in chat in order to evaluate it.
flintclient.ncr.gui.safety_status.undefi: No Chat Reports could not evaluate the safety of this server. This should never happen, please report it as a bug to the mod developer.
flintclient.ncr.gui.signing_status.allow: Chat signing is always enabled on Realms, since it is always required and disabling it would yield no benefit anyways.
Message signing is enabled for this session.
Message signing is enabled for this session, but it will be disabled once you re-join.
flintclient.ncr.gui.signing_status.disab: Message signing is disabled for this session.
Message signing is disabled for this session, but it will be enabled once you send any message.
Message signing is disabled since this is an offline server.
flintclient.ncr.gui.reload_config_toolti: Reload No Chat Reports config. Use carefully.
flintclient.ncr.gui.verified_server:
§a§lSafe Server§r
We could verify that this server has No Chat Reports installed, or prevents chat reports in some other known way. You can chat safely there.
flintclient.ncr.gui.ncr_toggle_tooltip:
§lNo Chat Reports:§r %1$s
Disable or enable most of the mod's client-sided functionality. You may have to do this to join some Paper/Velocity servers, as they are known to cause issues with NCR.
Certain networking-unrelated things, such as chat trust status tweaks and removal of vanilla's "Chat messages can't be verified" toast will still work; they can be disabled in config individually.
flintclient.ncr.gui.realms_warning.conte: Realms servers are not private. Realm owners cannot disable chat reporting and Mojang employs additional chat monitoring to identify potential "online harms" and escalate them to human review. If you are then found to violate Minecraft's Community Standards - even if the chat participants did not get offended - you will be banned, temporarily or permanently, from all multiplayer services.
flintclient.ncr.gui.signing_required.con:
This server requires all chat messages to be signed, which means they can be reported to Mojang, which may result in a ban from all multiplayer servers. This likely means that the server owner kept "enforce-secure-profile" enabled in the server.properties, which is the default since 1.19.1.

Click "Allow Signing" to enable message signing for this session. You can also use the safety status button in the chat screen to select the signing mode for this server.
flintclient.ncr.gui.signing_required.che: Don't show again during this session
flintclient.ncr.chat.disabled.signing_re: The server refused to deliver an unsigned message. You can enable chat signing by changing your signing mode or through a prompt screen.
This mode automatically enables message signing as soon as you enter the server, identically to how a vanilla client would.
flintclient.ncr.gui.signing_mode.never.t: In this mode, messages are never signed and all server requests to sign them are ignored.
flintclient.ncr.gui.signing_mode.never_f: This mode indicates that your messages cannot be signed at all, either because you are using an offline account or because the client failed to fetch your signing keys from Mojang's service.
In this mode, messages are not signed by default, but if the server demands signing, you will be shown a pop-up screen where you can enable signing for one session.
flintclient.ncr.gui.signing_mode.on_dema: Similar to prompt mode, but instead of showing a pop-up screen, signing will just be enabled automatically as soon as the server demands it.
